plt.xticks(v1.year,rotation=45); plt.ylabel('Motorist deaths (people)'); plt.xlabel('Year'); plt.title('Motorist deaths in NYC police-reported crashes, 2013–2025'); plt.grid(axis='y',alpha=.25); plt.annotate(f'{int(v1.motorist_deaths.iloc[0])}',(v1.year.iloc[0],v1.motorist_deaths.iloc[0]),xytext=(5,8),textcoords='offset points'); plt.annotate(f'{y.iloc[-1]:.1f}',(x.iloc[-1],y.iloc[-1]),xytext=(-27,8),textcoords='offset points'); plt.tight_layout(); plt.savefig(out/'option_2.png',dpi=160); plt.close(); print(df.to_string(index=False));
